examples_zh: 周五下午2点半在302开信息安全培训，各部门来2个骨干，自带电脑提前10分钟签到，帮我写个150字以内的通知发群里。
这段汇报AI味太重了，帮我改得自然点，里面的数字别动：“三季度我办多措并举全面赋能安全排查，共检查企业120家，整改隐患32处，剩下3处月底前弄完，注：数据为初步汇总，仅供参考。”
帮我把刚开会的记录理成会议纪要：18号王副总开会定了门禁改造控制在30万以内，信息部下月20号前上线；访客收费标准还没定，等法务核完政策下次再议。
我要给领导打一份设备采购请示，采购清单、几家报价和预算我都准备好了，发你帮我写成正式请示。
这几个月的零散工作记录我贴给你，帮我理成一份工作总结，下周汇报要用。
这份汇报写太长了，领导只要800字以内，帮我压一下，关键数字和还没办完的事别删掉。
这份稿子快要发出去了，帮我把把关，看看有没有写错的地方，或者哪里读着别扭。
这份通知的内容已经定好了，帮我直接排成规范的公文 Word 发我。
examples_en: Info-security training is this Friday at 2:30 PM in Room 302—2 key staff per team, bring laptops, sign in 10 minutes early. Write me a Chinese notice under 150 chars to drop in our group chat.

This Chinese update sounds too robotic—rewrite it naturally without changing the numbers: 'In Q3 our office took multiple measures to empower safety checks of 120 firms, fixed 32 hazards with 3 due by month-end; note: figures are preliminary and for reference only.'

Turn these meeting notes into Chinese minutes: on the 18th VP Wang approved the access-control upgrade within 300k yuan for IT launch by the 20th next month; visitor fee rules aren't decided yet pending Legal's policy check.
I need to send a hardware purchase request to management—I have the item list, vendor quotes, and budget ready, please turn them into a formal Chinese request.
Here are my scattered work notes from the past few months—help me turn them into a Chinese work summary for next week's briefing.
This Chinese report is too long—please trim it under 800 characters for management, keeping the key figures and unfinished items.
This Chinese draft is about to go out—please review it and let me know if anything looks wrong or reads awkwardly.
The notice text is finalized—please format it into a clean standard official Word document for me.
